choice: Explicit listener startup failure; no short-path fallback. The MCP client already uses the configured endpoint, so relocation would silently mismatch client/server paths.
failure_contract: serve_ipc validates encoded bytes before unlink/socket creation, clears readiness, emits one byte-count-only ERROR and raises IPCSocketPathError. app._ipc_server catches that configuration error and remembers the rejected fixed path, preventing duplicate diagnostics on Hub reconnects. A changed configured endpoint can retry. _run_once cleanup also consumes non-cancellation IPC task exceptions, clears readiness, and logs only their type; no raw exception/path and no propagation into the Hub connection caller.

limits.reason: Linux sun_path 108 bytes including terminating NUL; elsewhere use existing setup.py portable budget. Actual bind boundary exercised on Linux only.

checks: real maximum-length bind and IPC error response, ready flag set then cleared on cancellation
oversized path: exact error type and one diagnostic line, no path leakage, no socket creation, preexisting file retained, stale ready flag cleared
multibyte oversized path counted by encoded bytes rather than character count
